_: Every web font this site uses, built from the google/fonts repo by `pnpm fonts:sync`.
Nothing in the build fetches a font from Google: pages load these files through
next/font/local, OG images read the .ttf instances from disk. See README.md here.
Per family: `italic: true` also builds the italic face; `weights` lists the static
weights to keep for a family that has no variable font (omit = the Regular only);
`og` lists the static weights to instance as .ttf for Satori (OG images);
`files` names a static family's source files when the repo does not call them
